changelog: Vortex v5.5.38: every match-history view (Account Manager, Dashboard / Live Stats, player lookup) now renders one cohesive grid row - agent, map, date, result, K/D/A, KD, HS% - with the map art dimmed so the numbers stay readable. Closed-game dashboard is simplified: one theme-coloured 'Play VALORANT' button in Start a Match, no duplicate top PLAY button or 'VALORANT isn't running' card.
